title: Blue Pass EXChAngE - Project publication
reference:
Laušević, R. (Ed.) (2022). Blue Pass EXChAngE - Project publication. Institute of Marine Biology,
University of Montenegro. 46 pp.
publisher: Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro
description: Project „Explore Cross-border Aquatic Biodiversity – EXChAngE” publication presents main project result: new crossborder tourism product – the Blue Pass, which enables visits of new thematic routes: Dubrovnik and Aquarium (Croatia), Kotor and Aquarium Boka (Montenegro), Hutovo Blato Aqua Path, and Mostar Aqua Path (Bosnia and Herzegovina), and attracts more tourists in the area.
